title: Patchcord application manifest (v2)
description: The patchcord-app.yaml manifest an installed application declares (vision doc §7.6, §9.3, §15.4). Adds permissions.connectors.use to v1's workflows.run, additively (ADR-0071) — internal/apps.ParseManifest accepts this shape today. capabilities from the vision document is still deliberately not part of this schema: there is no enforcement point for it yet, the same situation plugin permissions are in.

id.description: Unique identifier of the application, used in its serving URL (/apps/{id}/) and in the sessions it issues.

run.description: Workflow ids this application's sessions are allowed to run. A session issued for this application can never run a workflow outside this list.

use.description: Connector ids a run started by this application's sessions is allowed to bind to a workflow step. Checked at connector-resolution time (uniformly for every way a step can reference a connector), not upfront when the run is created. A session with no connectors.use entry (or none declared at all) cannot resolve any connector-bound step.
